name: money-moves
description: A skills-first personal finance workflow for daily briefs, spend-down tracking, and practical cash-flow decisions using financial context already available in ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your financial context into clear daily money decisions.
interface.longDescription: Money Moves uses financial context already available in ChatGPT plus your own limits and rules to produce morning briefs, evening change reports, category spend-down trackers, and practical next-step guidance.
defaultPrompt: Give me my Money Moves brief.
Set up a morning brief and an evening changes-only brief.

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only Money Moves release with daily briefs, evening change summaries, monthly spend-down tracking, stale-data handling, and recurring-charge change detection.
